confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors use Hangzhou city price data near the July 2026 window; hostel prices are city averages. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and estimated at about 4.4 and 3.5 times local draft beer, respectively. Hotel prices are holistic estimates.
